en.headline: Hong Kong’s largest community living room opens in Tsuen Wan
en.dek: The 7,000-square-foot facility is the sixth new living room opened this year and is expected to serve about 610 subdivided-flat households, Chief Secretary Chan Kwok-ki said.
body: Hong Kong’s largest community living room, measuring about 7,034 square feet, officially opened in Tsuen Wan on Monday, Chief Secretary for Administration Chan Kwok-ki said at the ceremony.

Chan said the facility is the sixth new community living room delivered this year, meeting the target set in the previous Policy Address ahead of schedule. Combined with the Tsuen Wan West living room that opened earlier, the two centres can serve about 1,100 subdivided-flat households in the district. The new venue is expected to handle around 92,000 visits a year.

Operated by Yan Chai Hospital on premises provided by Chinachem Group, the centre offers shared kitchens, study spaces, laundry facilities, a fencing training area with coaches, and other support services. Chan said the total number of community living rooms citywide has reached 15, with three more planned by year-end to bring the total to 18.

zh.headline: 全港最大社區客廳在荃灣開幕
zh.dek: 政務司司長陳國基表示，實用面積約7,000平方呎的荃灣社區客廳是今年第六間新設施，料可惠及約610個劏房戶。
body: 全港最大的社區客廳周一在荃灣舉行開幕典禮，政務司司長陳國基出席並致辭。
陳國基表示，該社區客廳實用面積約7,034平方呎，是今年推出的第六間新社區客廳，已提早達標。連同早前投入服務的荃灣西社區客廳，兩間合共可服務區內約1,100個劏房戶，新客廳全年服務人次料達約92,000。
設施由華懋集團提供場地、仁濟醫院營運，設有共用廚房、自修室、洗衣區、劍擊訓練區及駐場教練等。陳國基指全港現有15間社區客廳，年底前料再有三間落成，總數達18間，當局會繼續物色地點惠及更多有需要住戶。
